iv_ev_rules.iv_range: 0 to 31 per stat (determined when encountered/hatched; cannot be changed in Emerald).
iv_ev_rules.ev_caps: Maximum 255 EVs per single stat (252 is the effective maximum because 255 / 4 floors to 63), and maximum 510 total EVs across all six stats.
iv_ev_rules.stat_scaling: Every 4 EVs in a stat grants +1 stat point at Level 100 (scales proportionally by level: Math.floor((EV / 4) * (Level / 100))).
iv_ev_rules.vitamins: HP Up, Protein, Iron, Calcium, Zinc, and Carbos each grant +10 EVs in their respective stat, up to a cap of 100 EVs per stat.
iv_ev_rules.multipliers: Macho Brace doubles EVs gained from battle (2x) while halving Speed in battle. Pokerus also doubles EVs gained (2x), stacking multiplicatively with Macho Brace for 4x EVs.
iv_ev_rules.exp_share_rule: In Generation III, any Pokemon that gains Experience Points from a battle (including via Exp. Share or switching out) receives the full base EV yield of the defeated Pokemon.
